blockers: The face is effectively a blank white mask at native scale; the minimal eyes and mouth do not establish a readable expression and become especially uncanny in the oblique views.
Celina does not yet read as a controlled, elegant rapier user. The locomotion is predominantly a generic narrow humanoid walk with limited torso, shoulder, and weapon-body relationship.
The gesture strip lacks a clear anticipation, decisive action, overshoot, and settle. Most frames appear to preserve the same rigid body pose while only the arm or rapier shifts.

Dark navy torso, lower body, and shadow regions collapse together at native scale, obscuring the corset, waist, and leg separation. The intended brass trim is too sparse to support material readability.

The render has soft, gradient-heavy edges and tiny anti-aliased details that do not resolve into deliberate pixel clusters at 1x. The 4x nearest-neighbor sheet exposes blur and unstable edge widths rather than a clean retro sprite language.
high_value_changes: Redesign the head at native 1x: use a clear dark hair or head silhouette, a deliberate eye placement, and one readable facial cue instead of a featureless white oval. Validate every cardinal and diagonal view at 128px height.

Increase value separation within the costume: establish a distinct near-black silhouette for the corset/undersuit, a separate blue armor value, and a controlled brass highlight reserved for collar, waist, and weapon fittings.

Give the silhouette a stronger shape rhythm: narrow head, assertive high collar, visibly pinched waist, differentiated hips, and an unmistakable rapier arm. Do not rely on the sword alone to supply asymmetry.

Rebuild the idle as restrained motion rather than near-static frame variation. Add a small timed weight transfer, collar/chest expansion, sword-tip counter-motion, and a deliberate return to the anchor pose.

Reauthor the walk with actual contact, passing, and propulsion phases. The feet need visibly planted contact frames, clearer hip travel, and corresponding counter-rotation through the shoulders and rapier hand.

Make the signature gesture legible in silhouette: add a preparatory withdrawal, a clean arm-and-rapier line, a brief held pose, and a controlled recovery. Keep the torso restrained but allow the weapon to provide the kinetic punctuation.
Inspect and clean the source at native 192x192 before enlargement. Replace mushy subpixel shading with clustered pixels, consistent one-pixel contours, and intentionally limited highlight ramps.
optional_notes: The 119.9px standing height and 0px reported anchor drift satisfy the technical contract, but the static inspection visually reads closer to a 120px asset with excessive empty space; use that remaining space to improve silhouette width and gesture without exceeding the limit.
The silhouette mask is identifiable, but it is too dependent on the long rapier and does not communicate the corset, controlled posture, or personality by body shape alone.

The light-background inspection exposes the white face and white gloves as disconnected high-contrast blobs. On dungeon backgrounds these may disappear less, but they still do not form a coherent material hierarchy.
The oblique directions show a head treatment that changes from white face to dark cap-like mass, producing a discontinuous character identity across the directional set.
regressions_from_previous: No prior-round visual sheets or comparison captures were provided, so specific regressions cannot be verified.

Relative to the stated archetype, the current candidate still appears to regress conceptually toward a generic armored mannequin: the deliberate, restrained rapier-user identity is not sufficiently visible in the motion sheets.
strongest_improvements: Technical compliance is solid: the measured standing height is under the 128px limit and the reported ground anchor drift is zero.
The front-facing silhouette is narrow and immediately distinguishable from a broad or heavily armored NPC.
The rapier provides useful asymmetry and remains visible across most directional views.
The blue armor against the dark inspection background has a workable initial contrast hierarchy, even though internal costume separation is insufficient.
luna_evaluation.single_most_important_next_change: Rebuild the native-scale head and upper-body silhouette together so Celina reads as a composed, elegant rapier duelist rather than a faceless blue mannequin; then retime the idle and gesture around that clarified pose.
